Prior work supports strong simple controls before attributing gains to a gated residual. [Petrov et al. (2026)](https://research.atspotify.com/2026/10/do-sequential-recommendation-benchmarks-require-higher-order-sequence-modelling/) compare last-item Markov models, recency-weighted pairwise-history models, SASRec and eSASRec under matched protocols. A pairwise model beats both Transformers on four of five benchmarks; history-aware pairwise models outperform last-item controls throughout. These datasets differ from the four target categories. [SimpleX](https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.12613) provides an order-insensitive collaborative-filtering baseline and demonstrates that loss and negative-sampling choices can materially affect comparisons. Recency-weighted pooling remains order-sensitive through its weights, despite lacking contextual interactions.

Implementation details can confound residual gains. The [original SASRec code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kang205/SASRec/master/model.py) enables input-embedding scaling, adds positional embeddings, normalizes attention queries and FFN inputs, and applies final LayerNorm; it should not automatically be equated with a standard modern pre-LN Transformer. [Xiong et al.](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/xiong20b.html) establish that normalization placement changes initialization gradients. Compare raw versus scaled pooled embeddings and normalization before versus after residual addition; record branch norms and gate values.

[ReZero](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v161/bachlechner21a/bachlechner21a.pdf) establishes zero-initialized learned residual scaling. Algebraically, for h=f+αr, α=0 initially blocks task gradients into parameters exclusive to r, while α can learn; shared embeddings still receive other gradients. A sigmoid gate with zero logit starts at 0.5, whereas strongly negative logits suppress both contribution and gate sensitivity. Recommended attribution ablations: last-item, uniform pooling, exponential pooling alone, fixed-weight residual and learned gate, with matched training settings. The sources establish related components, not the exact proposed combination.
